en: Qinwen, congratulations.
What an unbelievable performance
that was.
But I have to ask in the previous round
against Madison Keys,
you were down five zero in the third set.
Here again in the first set,
how are you making these comebacks?
Well, honestly,
I have to say I start the match not so well
and after, little by little, I find
my rhythm on the center court cuz it's
been a long long time I haven't play
on the center court,
I just really appreciate it to be here
in the Ashe Stadium first.
Yeah.
And second, I just focus point by point
and little by little I start
to play better tennis.
I start to find my game
and in one moment I even forgot the score
in the first set at 4-5.
That shows how I am focused.
Well I guess to come back 0-5 yesterday
is not lucky.
That's all I can say.
It's been a very difficult head-to-head
with Iga.
She's won six out of six matches.
What did you do differently today?
Well,
I think in the baseline I try to play more flat
against her because I think she's
has really good top spin.
Makes me feel really uncomfortable
and I try to play more aggressive
because I remember when I just came
on the tour the match I lost against her
is because I wasn't aggressive enough
and I tried to stay with her as long as I can.
I'm just really happy to match
because it's not easy
and it's been a while really.
I didn't beat any top 10 player.
I just really really appreciated this win
for me.
And I want to say thank you for all the fans
who come to support me today.
And I hope you guys enjoy tennis.
And last thing I want
to say thanks to my team
because we've been working really hard.
That's why I'm here.
Qinwen, you were out with injury
for quite some time.
You made it through the qualifying here,
but now you're into the quarterfinals.
You're playing some
of the best tennis we've ever seen from you.
Are you ready to keep going?
Well, I have to say more matches I play,
more rhythm I got on court.
People often ask me if you are tired.
I mean, when I arrive to here,
I'm not tired at all.
I just feel really pumped for my next match.
Trying to reach better level here.
Trying to show my tennis
and enjoy at this fantastic stadium.
Congratulations.
